title: Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning
summary: Activation patching showed that image and text tokens have distinct domain-shift patterns and that layer-wise patterns were stable across two driving datasets. The proposed MoLaRx selective-repair method had the lowest cross-city trajectory-error gap in six tested settings across three VLM planners; conclusions are limited to those models and benchmarks.
ai_technology: Vision-language models with layer-local image and text sensitivity
